comment: The Gravion model registry — Gravion AI's own model entries and variants. Status 'available' means the registry entry and module/bundle packaging path can be resolved. The weights_status field is authoritative for weights: every bundled Gravion entry includes local sparse n-gram classifier weights trained only from its bundled Gravion-owned seed corpus, with a deterministic fallback. A deployment may register private variants by placing its own models.json in the deployment home; the same schema and validation apply.

models.name: Gravion Core
models.notes: The built-in local Gravion Core model inside every Gravion deployment. It includes a sparse n-gram embedding + direct linear softmax classifier (10,586,543 parameters counted from stored quantized weights) trained only from the bundled Gravion corpus of 5,657 examples across 779 answer classes, and falls back to a deterministic offline responder when no confident trained match is available. It runs with no network and no API key.
